title: Trends
description: How months compare: income and where it went, the averages over longer periods, and what each category cost.

list.name: last_month
list.label: Last full month
list.description: Feeds the links to the Ledger; not shown.
list.query: select to_char(max(month_start), 'YYYY-MM-DD') as __value, to_char(max(month_start), 'Mon YYYY') as __text from marts.fct_month_plan where is_complete_month
list.definition: select to_char(max(month_start), 'YYYY-MM-DD') as __value, to_char(max(month_start), 'Mon YYYY') as __text from marts.fct_month_plan where is_complete_month

panels.title: Income and where it went
panels.description: The last 12 full months and this month so far. Bars: what left chequing as needs, wants and financial future. Line: the income received in each full month; the separate point is this month's income so far. Where the line sits above the bar, the gap is unallocated cash; a bar above the line means more left chequing than came in, paid from money already there.

targets.rawSql:
select
  s.month_start::timestamp at time zone 'America/Toronto' as time,
  s.needs_spend as "Needs",
  s.wants_spend as "Wants",
  s.financial_future as "Financial future",
  case when s.is_complete_month then s.spendable_income end as "Income",
  case when not s.is_complete_month then s.spendable_income end as "Income so far"
from (
  select s.*
  from marts.fct_monthly_summary s
  order by s.month_start desc
  limit 13
) s
order by s.month_start

panels.title: Months in numbers
panels.description: The figures behind the chart above: income received and each bucket as a share of it. Shares add up to 100%; unallocated is below zero when more left chequing than came in.

targets.rawSql:
select
  to_char(s.month_start, 'Mon YYYY') || case when s.is_complete_month then '' else ' (so far)' end as "Month",
  s.spendable_income as "Income",
  s.needs_pct as "Needs",
  s.wants_pct as "Wants",
  s.financial_future_pct as "Financial future",
  s.unallocated_pct as "Unallocated"
from marts.fct_monthly_summary s
order by s.month_start desc
limit 13

panels.title: Average bucket shares
panels.description: Each bucket as a share of income over the last 3, 6 and 12 full months, next to its target. A period shows a dash until that many full months exist.

targets.rawSql:
select "Period", "Needs", "Wants", "Financial future", "Unallocated"
from (
  select r.window_months as ord,
    'Last ' || r.window_months || ' full months' as "Period",
    r.needs_pct as "Needs", r.wants_pct as "Wants",
    r.financial_future_pct as "Financial future", r.unallocated_pct as "Unallocated"
  from marts.fct_month_rolling r
  where r.month_start = (select max(month_start) from marts.fct_month_plan where is_complete_month)
  union all
  select 99, 'Target', s.needs_target_pct, s.wants_target_pct, s.financial_future_target_pct, null
  from marts.fct_monthly_summary s
  where s.month_start = (select max(month_start) from marts.fct_month_plan)
) t
order by ord

panels.title: Recurring and one-off spending by month
panels.description: Your spending each month, split by whether the entry belongs to a recurring series (rent, bills, subscriptions) or not. The last 12 full months and this month. * marks this month so far.

targets.rawSql:
select
  to_char(p.month_start, 'Mon YY') || case when p.is_complete_month then '' else '*' end as month,
  coalesce(sum(f.amount) filter (where f.is_recurring), 0) as "Recurring",
  coalesce(sum(f.amount) filter (where not f.is_recurring), 0) as "One-off"
from (select * from marts.fct_month_plan order by month_start desc limit 13) p
left join marts.fct_transactions f on f.month_start = p.month_start and f.type = 'expense' and f.is_self_funded
group by p.month_start, p.is_complete_month
order by p.month_start

panels.title: Wants by category and month
panels.description: The last 12 full months, newest first: what each wants category cost. Colour compares a category with its own months, so a stronger colour is a heavier month for that category. Click an amount for its line items. Categories under 1% of the bucket's total are left out.

targets.rawSql:
select month, category, spend from (
select
  to_char(c.month_start, 'YYYY-MM') as month,
  c.category_name as category,
  sum(c.spend) as spend,
  sum(sum(c.spend)) over (partition by c.category_name) as category_total,
  sum(sum(c.spend)) over () as bucket_total
from marts.fct_subcategory_month c
join marts.fct_month_plan p using (month_start)
where p.is_complete_month and c.bucket = 'wants'
  and c.month_start > (select max(month_start) from marts.fct_month_plan where is_complete_month) - interval '12 months'
group by c.month_start, c.category_name
having sum(c.spend) <> 0
) small
where category_total >= 0.01 * bucket_total
order by category_total desc, 2, 1

panels.title: Needs by category and month
panels.description: The last 12 full months, newest first: what each needs category cost. Colour compares a category with its own months, so a stronger colour is a heavier month for that category. Click an amount for its line items. Categories under 1% of the bucket's total are left out.

targets.rawSql:
select month, category, spend from (
select
  to_char(c.month_start, 'YYYY-MM') as month,
  c.category_name as category,
  sum(c.spend) as spend,
  sum(sum(c.spend)) over (partition by c.category_name) as category_total,
  sum(sum(c.spend)) over () as bucket_total
from marts.fct_subcategory_month c
join marts.fct_month_plan p using (month_start)
where p.is_complete_month and c.bucket = 'needs'
  and c.month_start > (select max(month_start) from marts.fct_month_plan where is_complete_month) - interval '12 months'
group by c.month_start, c.category_name
having sum(c.spend) <> 0
) small
where category_total >= 0.01 * bucket_total
order by category_total desc, 2, 1

panels.title: Biggest changes last month, by category
panels.description: The last full month against the mean of the 3 full months before it, by category, largest change first. A positive change is more spending. Click a category for last month's line items, or a mean for the 3 months behind it.

targets.rawSql:
select
  c.category_name as "Category",
  initcap(c.bucket) as "Bucket",
  sum(c.spend) as "Last full month",
  sum(c.spend_avg_3m) as "Mean of previous 3",
  sum(c.spend) - sum(c.spend_avg_3m) as "Change"
from marts.fct_subcategory_month c
where c.month_start = (select max(month_start) from marts.fct_month_plan where is_complete_month)
  and c.baseline_months > 0
group by c.bucket, c.category_name
having sum(c.spend) - sum(c.spend_avg_3m) <> 0
order by abs(sum(c.spend) - sum(c.spend_avg_3m)) desc
limit 10

value.title: See the line items of the 3 full months before

panels.title: Biggest changes last month, by subcategory
panels.description: The last full month against the mean of the 3 full months before it, by subcategory, largest change first. A positive change is more spending. Click a category for last month's line items, or a mean for the 3 months behind it.

targets.rawSql:
select
  c.category_name as "Category", c.subcategory_name as "Subcategory",
  initcap(c.bucket) as "Bucket",
  sum(c.spend) as "Last full month",
  sum(c.spend_avg_3m) as "Mean of previous 3",
  sum(c.spend) - sum(c.spend_avg_3m) as "Change"
from marts.fct_subcategory_month c
where c.month_start = (select max(month_start) from marts.fct_month_plan where is_complete_month)
  and c.baseline_months > 0
group by c.bucket, c.category_name, c.subcategory_name
having sum(c.spend) - sum(c.spend_avg_3m) <> 0
order by abs(sum(c.spend) - sum(c.spend_avg_3m)) desc
limit 10

value.title: See the line items of the 3 full months before

panels.title: Recurring commitments
panels.description: Each recurring series paid in the last 3 full months: its latest amount, when it was last paid, and in how many of those months it appeared. A series that stopped appearing may be one you cancelled; one you no longer use is one to cancel.

targets.rawSql:
with last as (
  select max(month_start) as m from marts.fct_month_plan where is_complete_month
), e as (
  select l.*, row_number() over (partition by recurring_series_name order by occurred_on desc, transaction_id) as rn
  from marts.fct_ledger_entry l, last
  where l.is_recurring and l.type = 'expense' and l.recurring_series_name is not null
    and l.month_start > last.m - interval '3 months' and l.month_start <= last.m
)
select
  recurring_series_name as "Series",
  max(recurring_cadence) as "Cadence",
  max(initcap(bucket_summary)) filter (where rn = 1) as "Bucket",
  max(amount) filter (where rn = 1) as "Latest amount",
  to_char(max(occurred_on), 'YYYY-MM-DD') as "Last paid",
  count(distinct month_start) as "Months of 3"
from e
group by 1
order by 4 desc, 1

panels.title: Top merchants, last 3 full months
panels.description: Where your own spending went by merchant over the last 3 full months. Entries logged without a merchant are grouped in one row.

targets.rawSql:
select "Merchant", "Spent", "Per month", "Purchases" from (
select
  coalesce(merchant_name, venue_name, 'No merchant recorded') as "Merchant",
  sum(amount) as "Spent",
  sum(amount) / 3 as "Per month",
  count(distinct transaction_id) as "Purchases"
from marts.fct_transactions
where type = 'expense' and is_self_funded and month_start >= (select max(month_start) from marts.fct_month_plan where is_complete_month) - interval '2 months' and month_start <= (select max(month_start) from marts.fct_month_plan where is_complete_month)
group by 1
) m
order by ("Merchant" = 'No merchant recorded'), "Spent" desc
limit 10

panels.title: Largest purchases, last 3 full months
panels.description: The 10 largest line items of your own spending over the last 3 full months.

targets.rawSql:
select
  to_char(occurred_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as "Date",
  coalesce(item_description, description) as "Item",
  category_name as "Category",
  initcap(bucket) as "Bucket",
  amount as "Amount"
from marts.fct_transactions
where type = 'expense' and is_self_funded and month_start >= (select max(month_start) from marts.fct_month_plan where is_complete_month) - interval '2 months' and month_start <= (select max(month_start) from marts.fct_month_plan where is_complete_month)
order by amount desc, occurred_on desc, line_key
limit 10

panels.title: Wants by weekday
panels.description: Mean one-off wants spending per calendar day, by weekday, over every full month. Days with no spending count as zero; recurring payments are left out because a bill's date is not a habit.

targets.rawSql:
with d as (
  select d.date_day from marts.dim_date d join marts.fct_month_plan p using (month_start) where p.is_complete_month
), w as (
  select occurred_on, sum(amount) as amount
  from marts.fct_transactions
  where type = 'expense' and is_self_funded and bucket = 'wants' and not is_recurring
  group by 1
)
select to_char(d.date_day, 'Dy') as weekday, avg(coalesce(w.amount, 0)) as "Mean wants per day"
from d left join w on w.occurred_on = d.date_day
group by 1, extract(isodow from d.date_day)
order by extract(isodow from d.date_day)

panels.title: Wants by days since pay
panels.description: Mean one-off wants spending per day, by how many days had passed since pay last landed (0 is pay day), over every full month. A pay day is a day that brought at least a quarter of its month's income. Tall bars on the left mean spending rises right after pay.

targets.rawSql:
with d as (
  select d.date_day from marts.dim_date d join marts.fct_month_plan p using (month_start) where p.is_complete_month
), pay as (
  select date_day from marts.fct_pace_day
  where series = 'spendable_income' and month_total > 0 and amount_day / month_total >= 0.25
), w as (
  select occurred_on, sum(amount) as amount
  from marts.fct_transactions
  where type = 'expense' and is_self_funded and bucket = 'wants' and not is_recurring
  group by 1
), o as (
  select d.date_day, d.date_day - (select max(p.date_day) from pay p where p.date_day <= d.date_day) as days_since
  from d
)
select days_since::text as "Days since pay", avg(coalesce(w.amount, 0)) as "Mean wants per day"
from o left join w on w.occurred_on = o.date_day
where days_since between 0 and 14
group by days_since
order by days_since
